title: The site agent takes the short road the first time on every CMS: a refused title search names one ready call (type filled in), content.read takes a CMS word for a type, a record id "post:26" is read as kind + id, CONFIRM_FIRST keeps the question id, tracy_emdash takes action for tool and a collection's label for its list, a stated wish is said to be kept, "as I told you before" with no notes is a question, a list's create is the whole add, page.text {match} names the pictures beside the words, an EmDash delete is one call in every language with one question for a burst of row deletes, a typed answer to the door's question is said to open nothing, and the tracy_site description says the contract language rule once
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.
S2: From the checkout root run the run.cmd below (node --test --test-reporter=tap over the eleven site-tools test files it names) — keep the 'ok'/'not ok' lines and the exit code.
expect: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. LIST_SEARCH_UNSUPPORTED's next is one call with the type filled in (content.read {type:"article"|"page"|"shared", locale, fields:"title,slug"}) and names native {kind, id} as the id content.get/content.delete take, within 200 characters; content.read {type:"post"} (and posts, articles, pages, menuItem, module, projects, services) is relayed as the Content API type with a normalized note, "news"/"blog" stay as asked; content.get/update/delete/language with id "post:26" or "article:552" are relayed as kind + number, a prefix that disagrees with kind is left to its refusal; every CONFIRM_FIRST next says the question id goes as given; tracy_emdash {action:"content_list"} runs content_list and {action:"list"} the catalogue, each said; content_list by a label one collection carries is read from that collection once, never a write; the step that starts a site-notes capture carries a 'tracy-site-tools:wish' notice and no other step does; the work rules carry 'So is one they say they gave before, unless a Site notes notice holds it: ask, it is in no file.'; every lists.create carries the whole-add note; page.text {match} answers pictures:[{near, src, alt?}] of the card holding the words (none for words in a grid of more than two pictures); the contract blocks point at the site context's language rule instead of quoting it; the tracy_emdash description names content_delete {collection, id}. EmDash: a burst of content_delete calls naming one entry in one step gets one full CONFIRM_FIRST and short ones with the same question, nothing deleted, then ONE confirmed call removes all languages; a typed answer to the door's question opens nothing and the next CONFIRM_FIRST (EmDash, WordPress, Joomla) carries typed:true with a next asking for a choice; the tracy_emdash description says content_delete is ONE call, all languages unless locale names one.

selectors.emdash: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/emdash.mjs (normalizeEmdashShape ED-10, soleCollection, EMDASH_DESCRIPTION), emdash-call.mjs (label list re-read)
selectors.context: site-notes.mjs WISH_KEPT + index.ts WISH_PLUGIN notice; site-context.mjs work rules; page-lists.mjs WHOLE_ADD
selectors.pictures: page.mjs picturesNear + pageAnswer; html-units.mjs renderedUnits images

evidence: Bench hb on the full local stand with DeepSeek, 09/10/2026, 13 generic cases x 3 CMS (benchwp02, benchjoomla02, benchemdash04), AFTER runs ~/tracy-bench-work/bench/out-v7-hbr2-after-r*-r1, out-v7-abl-hb-after3-*-r1, out-v7-hbr3-after-r*-r1: 143 turns, 830 tool calls; the 15 longest turns held 43% of the calls and 40% of the prompt tokens. Refusals: LIST_SEARCH_UNSUPPORTED 16 (followed by CONTENT_BAD_QUERY type:"post" 4), tracy_emdash without tool 7 BAD_CALL + 17 {list:true} schema lookups, COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND 'news' 5, ADDRESS_MISSING/bad_params on "post:26" 2, ask_user_question with an invented id 2; 'as I said before' negative control 4-15 calls searching files; wish turns 3-5 calls editing AGENTS.md (13-22 on EmDash); picture-of-project-X 11-17 calls; WordPress add 7-14 calls in 3 of 7 runs. EmDash hbr3 (image with a53cf0762): delete by chat sent 20 content_delete in one step, all refused CONFIRM_FIRST (30 calls, 265k prompt tokens); the pick variant failed after typed answers (18 steps, 517k tokens).
fence: Mechanism only: refusal nexts, normalization, notices, the pictures field and the description text. Not covered: whether a model then takes the short road (a bench measure on the stand).
